unavailable.title: Page management unavailable
unavailable.body: This feature is not open here yet.

create.title: Create a page
create.lead: A page presents an association, a business, a media outlet or a diaspora community. It speaks through its signatories, never on behalf of the State.

kindHint.association: A registered association, or one being registered.
kindHint.company: A business, a shop or an independent professional.
kindHint.media: A media outlet, a radio, a channel or a news blog.
kindHint.community: An informal collective, a mutual-aid group or a friendly society.

create.name: Page name
create.nameHint: The full name, as your members know it ({{max}} characters at most).
create.handleHint: Without an address, it is derived from the name. It cannot change afterwards.
create.descriptionHint: What the page does and for whom ({{max}} characters at most). No contact details: people reach you through messages.
create.countryHint: Where it operates: the page appears in that country's hub.
create.trustNote: A page created by a member carries the “Community” badge. The “Verified” badge comes from a claim approved by moderation; “Official” is reserved for institutions.
create.created: Page created: you are its administrator.

verifiedOnly.title: Creating a page is reserved for verified members
verifiedOnly.body: Your membership is currently: {{status}}. It becomes verified once your consular registration is verified, or with an IDN identity of level 2 and a sponsorship.

claim.title: Claim {{name}}
claim.lead: Do you represent this organisation? Ask to take over its management, with supporting documents.
claim.verifyLead: You administer this page: ask for its verification, with supporting documents.

how.title: How a claim works
how.evidence: Attach one to five documents: statutes, registration receipt, appointment minutes, company registration extract.
how.private: Your documents stay private: only DIASPORALE moderation and you can see them. They are never published.
how.decision: Moderation rules with a reasoned decision. If approved, you become an administrator and the page gets the “Verified” badge.
how.notOfficial: “Verified” is not “Official”: no claim grants official authority, which is reserved for institutions.
how.withdraw: While it is pending, you can withdraw your request: its documents are then erased.

claim.officialPage: An official page cannot be claimed: it belongs to the institution it represents.
claim.verifiedPage: This page is already verified. To dispute its management, report it to moderation.
claim.signatoryOnly: You sign for this page: only an administrator can request its verification.
claim.evidenceHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP; {{max}} documents at most, {{size}} MB each. They leave your device only when you send.
claim.mandateHint: A statement: the documents prove it, moderation assesses it.

mandate.board_member: Board member, mandated by the board

claim.detailsHint: Role, date and appointing body ({{max}} characters at most). No civil-status data.
claim.consent: I declare that I am mandated by this organisation and I agree that DIASPORALE moderation may consult these documents to review my request.
claim.sent: Request sent: moderation will review it.
claim.withdrawConfirmBody: It will not be reviewed and its documents will be erased. You can file a new one.
claim.withdrawn: Request withdrawn; its documents are erased.

manage.title: Manage {{name}}
manage.roleAdmin: You administer this page: identity, team and verification.
manage.roleSignatory: You sign for this page: you publish on its behalf, its administrators manage it.

notManager.title: You do not manage this page
notManager.body: Only its signatories have access. If your role was just removed, access closed immediately.

identity.title: Page identity
identity.lead: Name, acronym, description and country. The address does not change: a shared link must always lead to the page.
identity.history: Every change is kept in the page history.
identity.adminOnly: Only administrators edit the page identity.

images.title: Logo and banner
images.lead: JPEG, PNG or WebP images: 5 MB at most for the logo, 10 MB for the banner. Each image is scanned before it is shown.
images.removeBody: The image is removed from the page and erased.
images.pending: Image received: it will show once scanned.
images.quarantined: Image blocked by the scan: choose another one.

team.title: Page team
team.lead: Administrators publish and manage; signatories publish on behalf of the page. An appointment is an invitation: it only counts once accepted.
team.readOnly: Only administrators invite or remove signatories.
team.lastAdmin: You are the last administrator: appoint another one before leaving.
team.removeConfirmBody: This person will no longer publish or manage on behalf of the page. Access closes immediately.
team.leaveConfirmBody: You will no longer publish on behalf of the page. An administrator can invite you again.
team.inviteLead: Enter the handle of a DIASPORALE member: they will receive an invitation to accept.

verification.title: Page verification

state.official: Official page: its authority comes from the institution it represents, not from a claim.
state.verified: Verified page: a claim was approved by DIASPORALE moderation. This is not an official authority.
state.community: Community page: it has not been verified yet.

verification.adminOnly: Only an administrator can request verification.

myPages.title: My pages
myPages.lead: The pages on whose behalf you speak in DIASPORALE.
myPages.emptyTitle: You do not manage any page yet
myPages.emptyBody: Create your association's or business's page, or claim the one that already exists.

invitations.title: Invitations to sign
invitations.lead: A page invites you to publish on its behalf. Nothing changes until you accept.
invitations.accepted: Invitation accepted: you now sign for {{name}}.

review.title: Claims to review
review.lead: Reserved for DIASPORALE moderation. Every decision is reasoned and logged.
review.demoNote: Demo: Mireille reviews claims on behalf of moderation.
review.empty: No claim is awaiting a decision.
review.sheetDescription: Read the note and the documents, then rule with a reasoned decision.

decision.approved: Approve: the claimant becomes an administrator and the page becomes “Verified”
decision.rejected: Reject: nothing changes for the page

review.reasonHint: It is shared with the claimant ({{min}} to {{max}} characters).

errors.page_verified_required: Creating a page is reserved for verified members: have your consular registration verified, or link an IDN identity of level 2 with a sponsorship.
errors.page_kind_reserved: An institution page is not created here: it results from a platform decision.
errors.page_name_invalid: The page name has 1 to 120 characters.
errors.page_short_name_too_long: The acronym has 30 characters at most.
errors.page_description_too_long: The description has 1,000 characters at most.
errors.page_handle_length: The page address has 3 to 60 characters.
errors.page_handle_charset: Address: unaccented letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore; signs neither at the start nor at the end.
errors.page_handle_taken: This address is already taken: choose another one.
errors.page_post_country_required: To publish locally, the page must first declare its country (Manage the page, Identity tab).
errors.page_role_required: You do not have, or no longer have, the required role on this page.
errors.page_last_admin: A page always keeps at least one administrator: appoint another one first.
errors.page_signatories_full: A page has 50 signatories at most.
errors.page_signatory_identity_required: Signing for an official page requires an IDN identity of level 2.
errors.page_member_not_found: No DIASPORALE member matches this handle.
errors.page_already_claimed: This page already has an administrator: only one of them can request its verification.
errors.page_claim_pending: You already have a pending request for this page.
errors.page_claim_evidence_type: Accepted documents: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.page_claim_evidence_too_large: A document weighs 10 MB at most.
errors.page_claim_note_too_long: The note has 1,000 characters at most.
errors.page_claim_consent_required: Tick the statement to send your request.
errors.page_claim_closed: This claim is no longer awaiting a decision: already decided, or its author is no longer an active member.
errors.page_image_type_invalid: Accepted images: JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.page_image_too_large: Image too heavy: 5 MB at most for the logo, 10 MB for the banner.
